intuition: At most k stops permits at most k + 1 flight edges, so relax routes one edge-depth at a time.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every flight route within the edge limit and choose the cheapest destination route.

optimal.approach: Apply Bellman-Ford for k + 1 rounds using a snapshot of the previous round's distances.

edge_cases: The destination may be unreachable within the allowed stops.
Using more stops can reduce cost, so the edge limit must be respected.
